title: Community apps spread across art, video, and audio
summary:
Twenty community apps joined the catalog, while MCP gained a configurable endpoint for compatible gateways.

Six catalog additions cover video translation, short-video generation, music creation, French-language image generation, and two GIMP-related image projects. The recent-app lists rotated as new entries arrived; earlier apps were not necessarily removed from the catalog.

Eight community listings range from study guides, educational visuals, and collaborative storytelling to a German-language cyberpunk RPG. A horoscope app, dream-analysis app, and Telegram companion round out the mix.

Six more catalog entries cover blog drafting, turning rough notes into plans, prompt organization, a coding CLI, startup-idea analysis, and a self-hosted assistant. These PRs added listings, not changes to the apps themselves.

highlights.title: Point MCP at your gateway
highlights.text: Set `POLLINATIONS_BASE_URL` to use the MCP server with a local or self-hosted compatible gateway, including one under a path prefix. Generation, account, and model requests all use that endpoint. [MCP server docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs#tag/mcp-servers).
